waived.cream-palette: Deliberate, not reflex. The organisation's own printed appeals are set on warm newsprint; this page is a direct descendant of that poster. The palette is newsprint + crimson + marigold, and the supporter card inverts to near-black, so the page is not wall-to-wall warm off-white.
waived.gpt-thin-border-wide-shadow: Fixed rather than waived — the wide shadow is gone and the hairline edge stays. Kept here so a stray 1px+shadow reappearing gets noticed.
